author: opencode-worker-3
text: Superseded diagnosis: with the TX chain fixed (84908feee9 + 237dc35064), a full heft run shows the cascade root is NOT test isolation. Trace: disable_retries ends RUNNING+keyed (startup MLD/ND frames fail frame-build with -126 in the enable->reprovision window, then peer re-added) -> full_ping sends its Echo Request successfully -> loopback RX fails AUTHENTICATION (-200/LICHEN_EAUTH) on the self-addressed signed frame -> recv_async re-arm fails EBUSY 3x -> 'giving up, deinit/init required' -> module ABORTED -> full_ping wait times out (10s), queue_stats first read -125/ECANCELED, udp TX -ENETDOWN. Two real bugs, filed separately.
